description: IPC surface for the main window, which loads the loopback backend over HTTP — a remote origin to Tauri. Exposes exactly three commands: opener:open_url scoped to https URLs (broker OAuth approval pages in the system browser — the webview has no window.open handler), plus the app's own updater_state / run_self_update pair driving the Settings → Updates rebuild-from-source flow. Nothing else is reachable from the page.
